stories.name_fr: Croissance annuelle du BPA ajusté visée à long terme
stories.explanation: Objectif relevé de 12 à 14 % à 13 à 16 %.
stories.story_fr: McKesson vise une croissance du BPA ajusté de 13 à 16 % à long terme, contre 12 à 14 % auparavant.
stories.story_en: McKesson targets long-term adjusted EPS growth of 13% to 16%, up from 12% to 14% previously.
stories.citation: updating and increasing its long-term Adjusted Earnings per Diluted Share growth target to 13% to 16%, an increase from the prior range of 12% to 14%

stories.story_en: McKesson targets long-term adjusted operating profit growth of 13% to 16% for Oncology & Multispecialty.
